product_overview: In-TrackFin is a Laravel web application for managing logistics finance and shipment tracking. It supports role-based access for branch leaders and staff to handle authentication, shipment resi tracking, financial records, reports, and user management.
core_goals: Sign in and out of the application to access protected features
Track shipment resi records and update their statuses
Record, review, and manage operational expenses and income
Manage application users with role-based access for branch leaders

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can log in with email and password, receive validation feedback for incorrect input, and log out to end their session.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter a valid email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter an incorrect email or password -> Submit the login form -> See a credentials mismatch message
Navigate to /login -> Leave the email field empty -> Submit the login form -> See a required-field validation message
Navigate to /login -> Leave the password field empty -> Submit the login form -> See a required-field validation message
Navigate to /dashboard -> Log out -> See the login page

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Users can view a post-login summary of financial data and recent resi activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View the financial summary -> View the latest resi data

features.name: Tracking Resi
features.description: Authenticated users can view, create, edit, delete, and update shipment resi records.
user_flows: Navigate to /resi -> View the resi list -> Add a new resi record -> See the updated list
Navigate to /resi -> View an existing resi record -> Edit the resi details -> See the updated record
Navigate to /resi -> View an existing resi record -> Delete the resi record -> See the updated list
Navigate to /resi -> View an existing resi record -> Update the resi status -> See the status change reflected in the list

features.name: Expense Management
features.description: Authenticated users can view, add, edit, and delete operational expense records.
user_flows: Navigate to /expenses -> View the expense list -> Add a new expense record -> See the updated list
Navigate to /expenses -> View an existing expense record -> Edit the expense details -> See the updated record
Navigate to /expenses -> View an existing expense record -> Delete the expense record -> See the updated list

features.name: Income Management
features.description: Authenticated users can view, add, edit, and delete income records.
user_flows: Navigate to /incomes -> View the income list -> Add a new income record -> See the updated list
Navigate to /incomes -> View an existing income record -> Edit the income details -> See the updated record
Navigate to /incomes -> View an existing income record -> Delete the income record -> See the updated list

features.name: Financial Reports
features.description: Authorized users can review financial reports and export them in PDF or Excel format.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> View the financial report -> Export the report as PDF
Navigate to /reports -> View the financial report -> Export the report as Excel

features.name: User Management
features.description: Branch leaders can view, create, edit, and delete user accounts within the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /users -> View the user list -> Add a new user account -> See the updated list
Navigate to /users -> View an existing user account -> Edit the user details -> See the updated account
Navigate to /users -> View an existing user account -> Delete the user account -> See the updated list

features.name: Autentikasi - Login
features.description: Login menggunakan email dan password, dengan validasi dan pesan error
user_interactions: Lihat pesan error jika credentials salah
Diarahkan ke dashboard jika login berhasil

features.name: Autentikasi - Logout
features.description: Logout pengguna dan kembali ke halaman login

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Tampilan ringkasan data keuangan dan resi setelah login

known_limitations.issue: Akses halaman tertentu dibatasi berdasarkan role (Kepala Cabang vs Staff)
known_limitations.impact: Staff tidak dapat mengakses manajemen pengguna
